title: A natural number plus one is at most two to that power

steps.text: Lemma 1. For every natural number $n$, $n < 2^n$. Proof of the lemma: by induction on $n$. For $n = 0$ we have $0 < 1 = 2^0$. If $k < 2^k$, then $k + 1 \le 2^k < 2 \cdot 2^k = 2^{k+1}$.
By Lemma 1, $n < 2^n$; since both sides are natural numbers, $n + 1 \le 2^n$.

Lemma 2. For all $n \in \mathbb{N}$, $n^2 \ge n$. Proof of the lemma: $n^2 = n \cdot n$, and $n \cdot n \ge n \cdot 1 = n$ when $n \ge 1$, while $0^2 = 0$.
By Lemma 1, $n < 2^n$; since both sides are natural numbers, $n + 1 \le 2^n$.
